src/base-links.ts must build against the satteri that @astrojs/markdown-satteri uses, and Starlight and its plugins pin satteri too: one member bumped alone fails astro check on two copies
pyo3-ffi links the Python library, so Cargo refuses two pyo3 versions in one graph: pyo3 bumped past the range pyo3-log accepts fails to resolve
src/http.rs installs the ring provider on our rustls; a rustls that differs from reqwest's leaves reqwest without a provider, and it panics at runtime
@astrojs/check accepts TypeScript ^5 || ^6 only; a newer major fails npm ci
